events.title: First Annual Oktoberfest
events.address: Zarpe Pueblito Sur, Playas del Coco
events.description: Our collaboration Festbier with Potrero Brewing Co. on tap, an Oktoberfest pizza from Coco Pizza Company (pork belly, sauerkraut, sour cream and mustard drizzle) and live music from 2 Dudes.
events.description_es: Nuestra Festbier colaborativa con Potrero Brewing Co. en tap, pizza de Oktoberfest de Coco Pizza Company (panceta, chucrut, natilla y mostaza) y música en vivo con 2 Dudes.
